$comment: THE READ RECORD of slice s-09 of the 1985 rules (kb/Work PB5597; DESIGN-spec-conformance-review.md section 10.6): the reader's and the refuter's files and the flags the slice asked, verbatim, with the digest of each source. Written by audit_batch.py import-reads; read only through lineage_reads.load, the one normalization.

scope-1985: Identification Division required in every source program (header IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.)
Identification Division identifies the program
the user may add DATE-WRITTEN and other informational paragraphs

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.3.1 p1  (3.1 GENERAL DESCRIPTION)  the text is in p1
citations.quote: The Identification Division is required in a COBOL source program

cases.reason: "The Identification Division is required in a COBOL source program." 2023 makes the header optional (its 11.2.1 format brackets IDENTIFICATION DIVISION); no candidate states the 1985 requirement and none has an 85 case. The compiler refuses a header-less unit at 85 and accepts the informational paragraphs.
cases.needs: needs-own-witness: place the probe as the row's own 85 test

scope-1985: PROGRAM-ID must be the first paragraph
other paragraphs (AUTHOR, INSTALLATION, DATE-WRITTEN, DATE-COMPILED, SECURITY) optional
optional paragraphs in the order of the general format

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.3.2 p1  (3.2 ORGANIZATION)  the text is in p1
citations.quote: in order of presentation shown by the general format

cases.reason: "The name of the program must be given in the first paragraph, which is the PROGRAM-ID paragraph. The other paragraphs are optional ... in order of presentation shown by the general format below." The candidates (COMMON, REPOSITORY rules) state nothing of this; 2023 has no AUTHOR..SECURITY paragraphs.
cases.needs: needs-own-witness: place the probe as the row's own 85 test

scope-1985: AUTHOR, INSTALLATION, DATE-WRITTEN, DATE-COMPILED, SECURITY: obsolete elements, still part of Standard COBOL 1985 (Nucleus)

cases.reason: Flagged definitional, but a program shows it: an obsolete element is still present in its level (the module element tables mark it Z, "present ... however this element is an obsolete element"), so the five paragraphs must compile at 85. 2023 deleted them. The compiler accepts all five, comment-entries on one and two lines.
cases.needs: needs-own-witness: place the probe as the row's own 85 test
